meta.title: Mode Guide
meta.description: Not sure which of the four Agent presets to use? Describe your task in one sentence and the plugin recommends Standard / PTC / Minimal / Creative, with two verifiable sentences explaining why. The capability table is parsed from this version's preset definitions.

ui.triggerAria: Mode guide: describe a task to decide which Agent preset to use
ui.hint: Describe the task. Switch only if it needs a mode-exclusive tool.
ui.mnemonic: Default: stay put. Creative for plugins, Standard for workflows, Minimal for baselines.
ui.placeholder: e.g. Sort and rename 300 files in my Downloads folder by type
ui.fallbackNote: No model response; showing the rule-based recommendation.
ui.rateLimitedNote: Model review was called too often; try again in about {s}s. Showing the rule-based recommendation for now.
ui.rateLimitedNoteSoon: Model review was called too often; try again shortly. Showing the rule-based recommendation for now.
ui.alreadyDefault: This matches your default for new tasks; no switch needed.
ui.applyTimeout: Switch timed out; the host did not respond.
ui.manualHint: You can switch manually from the current mode label in the composer toolbar.
ui.lockedHint: This task has already started; its mode was fixed when it was created. Use this on your next new task.
ui.noRemote: Mode switching is not available in this environment.
ui.legend: Parsed from this version's preset definitions; refreshed live when the host exposes them. Only capabilities that differ are listed; ✓ yes  · no  ? depends on environment.
